summary: Rabbi Soffer explores the dialogue between Hashem and Avraham Abinu in Parashat Lech Lecha, focusing on the promise of offspring and the inheritance of the land. He examines Rashi's commentary on the Brit Ben HaBetarim, explaining the symbolism of the animals used in the covenant and the significance of Avraham Abinu's faith.
questions: Why did Hashem tell Avraham Abinu to step outside to look at the stars?
Why did Avraham Abinu ask for a sign regarding the inheritance of the land but not regarding the promise of children?
What is the significance of the specific animals used in the Brit Ben HaBetarim?
Why did Avraham Abinu chase away the vultures that came down on the carcasses?
How does the covenant relate to the future of the nations and the coming of Melech HaMashiach?
